statements.status_notes: ranger-plugins-common@2.7.0 is bundled in the druid-ranger-security extension (Druid 36.0.0 uses apache.ranger.version=2.7.0). Fix requires upgrading to Ranger 2.8.0, but the Druid 36.0.0 root pom carries an explicit warning that Ranger version bumps require aws-bundle-sdk vs aws-logs-sdk compatibility verification. Fix is blocked on a validated upstream Druid 36.x patch release. Monitor apache/druid upstream.
